title: Bulk menu import (CSV) with audit + publish gate
summary: Load menu structure via the Back Office import utilities; the workbench parses the same CSV shape this console exports for Lightspeed, audits it, and gates publication.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: a file under data/imports/ (a repo fixture is resolved as a fallback so the example runs)

steps.title: Prepare the CSV from an exported template
steps.instructions: Customize the Item list table (Edit table), export a shape to copy, fill rows: type (category/item), name, category, price, modifier groups, available yes/no.

steps.title: Import into the workbench (normalize on the way in)
CSVs carry group names without options — fold the artifacts (empty referenced groups are sync-breakers)
Full audit of the imported structure
Review + confirm (Back Office shows its own import preview — reconcile counts first)
steps.instructions: Import counts here must match the preview counts in the portal before confirming.
